name: Zhejiang Whyis Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Whyis Technology Co.,Ltd. provides information system integration and technical services to smart city industry in China. The company offers integrated solutions in the areas of project design, information system development, hardware and software procurement, and operation and maintenance services. It also provides smart port and shipping, prisons, public security, procuratorate, court, power, healthcare, buildings, smart city system operation and maintenance services, and proprietary products. Zhejiang Whyis Technology Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
